title: Evaluate on held-out test
summary: Reads the test part once: accuracy with Wilson intervals, and the witness frames at every epoch.
does: tools/evaluate.py over the run: the test part read once, each number a result row with its Wilson interval and stamp, and the witness frames drawn over every kept epoch. A second data input adds another held-out set, such as the catalog's real test frames beside a synthetic run. On the experiment route it runs in the training job; in the v1 flow its own job gets a quarter of the training hours, at least 0.25 (tools/flow.py), so 1 hour at the default 4.

inputs.name: data
inputs.what: Another held-out set with a test part.

outputs.name: metrics
outputs.what: Test scores with intervals, and the witness frames.

nondeterminism: A GPU forward pass may differ in its last bits between cards, so a borderline crop's guess can move; the scores are counted again, never assumed.

generic.why: It reads 2-D crops of a catalog's test part (tools/evaluate.py); a volume or a clip would need a reader of its own.
